Implementation Manager

Example Corp is hiring an Implementation Manager to lead customer onboarding from contract signature through go-live. You will own the implementation plan for a portfolio of accounts, coordinate across Sales, Support, and Product, and act as the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders during rollout. This is a high-ownership role on a small team, and you will have significant say in how the implementation process itself evolves.

Responsibilities include running kickoff calls, translating customer requirements into configuration work, managing timelines across many concurrent projects, performing quality checks before launch, and handing off cleanly to Customer Success once an account is live. You will also help build the documentation and repeatable processes that make each subsequent implementation faster than the last.

We are looking for someone comfortable with cloud platforms and able to learn complex software quickly, with strong written and verbal communication, and experience keeping many parallel workstreams organised without close supervision. Familiarity with project tracking tools and spreadsheets is expected; exposure to APIs, SSO, or integration work is a plus but not required.
